title: 第二十章 新邻居第二十一章 黏人三宝
content_zh:
楚相国坐在办公室里喝茶，上好的天山大红袍，价格不菲堪比钻石，即便身家早已是亿万的他，喝起来也是小心翼翼的，可见这茶的金贵。
结果，秦雪一个电话打过来，汇报完那七位数的修理费用后，他差点一口把嘴里的‘钻石’全都喷出来，修个捷达就花这么多钱，闹呢！
楚相国反应大，完全是因为这事，几百万对于他来说就像是普通人的几块钱，关键是上百万在国内买一辆宝马都足够了，还修一辆老捷达干嘛？
他是想不懂啊……
楚相国也没问原因，直接就对着电话道：“小秦啊，你直接签了就行。”
挂了电话，楚相国笑着摇头道：“这小子……”语气里却没有责怪的意思。
秦雪签完了单子，就和林昆一起从汽修厂里出来，徐广元一直送两人到上车，并且直到红色的凯迪拉克完全消失在了视野里，他才转身回去。
回去后，徐广元就找到了那位杨姓师傅，对他道：“小杨啊，这单活你歇着吧，我亲自干！”
凯迪拉克停在了海辰别墅区大门外，林昆刚要下车，秦雪突然叫住他，林昆回过头，就见秦雪微笑着看着他：“林先生……再给我根那烟。”
林昆愣了一下，笑着掏出了根烟，并替她点着。
秦雪深吸一口，似是一脸陶醉，道：“这味道真不错……这烟叫什么名字？”
林昆也给自己点了根，吐着烟圈道：“大青蛤蟆，漠北的烈烟，都是男人抽的。”
秦雪饶有兴致的问道：“那女人呢？”
林昆道：“那儿没女人。”
秦雪不相信。
林昆道：“真的，那儿太穷了，女人都嫁出去了，就剩下一群大老爷们成天跟我们这些当兵的对着干，穷山恶水多刁民，这话可一点都不假。”
林昆掏出了剩下的半包烟，丢到操控台上，“这半包送你了，少抽点。”
秦雪微笑：“谢谢。”
林昆笑了笑，从车上下来，秦雪又突然冲他道：“等你的车修好了，带我去兜兜风？”
林昆咧嘴一笑：“很荣幸。”

林昆大大咧咧的走进了别墅区，秦雪也开着凯迪拉克离开了，路上她叼着大青蛤蟆，嘴角噙着一抹淡淡的微笑，冷艳的脸颊上似有春风拂过。
林昆哼着小调向七号别墅走去，他打算先回去吃点东西，然后去一趟农贸市场，买些菜籽和种菜的工具回来，趁着下午有空把车库前的那小块菜地给种上。
路过六号别墅门口的时候，他突然停了下来，并主动向后退了两步，院子里一个算不上太熟悉但也熟悉的身影正在打扫卫生，是他前天晚上英雄救美的女主角章小雅，别墅门口前的台阶上摆满了大包小包的行李。
林昆眉头不由一蹙，这妮子怎么在这儿了，之前住这六号别墅的不是一家四口么，还有……小楚澄事后交代早上来家里找他的也是她，她怎么知道自己住这？
疑惑没有，想弄明白了就得自己去问。
“咳咳……”
林昆走进了小院，故意咳嗽了两声，章小雅正低头扫地，闻声抬起了头，一看是林昆，马上喜上眉梢，惊喜的道：“林大哥，你怎么来了！”
林昆嘴角笑了一下，道：“你怎么搬这来了？”
“我……”
章小雅迟疑一下，她当然不能实话实说了，否则还不得被林昆当成花痴，虽然这次她本来就挺花痴的，但也不能轻易的被知道啊，她红着小脸蛋说：“宿舍住的不舒服，就搬出来了，正好这家在卖房子，所以……”
从小到大，除了隐瞒自己的身世之外，章小雅几乎就没说过谎，这会儿话还没说完，脸已经红的滚烫起来，其中也有面对林昆紧张的原因。
林昆微微一阖眼，马上就知道这小妮子在说谎，反问一句到：“真的？”
“真，真的。”章小雅微微颔首，耳朵也跟着红起来了。
content_en:
Chu Xiangguo was sitting in his office drinking tea. The fine Tianshan Dahongpao was as expensive as diamonds. Even though he was already worth hundreds of millions, he drank it carefully, which showed how precious this tea was.
As a result, Qin Xue called and reported the seven-digit repair cost. He almost spit out all the diamonds in his mouth. It cost so much to repair a Jetta. How ridiculous!
Chu Xiangguo's big reaction was entirely because of this matter. To him, millions are like a few dollars for ordinary people. The key is that millions are enough to buy a BMW in China, so why repair an old Jetta?
He doesn't understand...
Chu Xiangguo didn't ask the reason, and just said to the phone: "Xiao Qin, you can just sign."
After hanging up the phone, Chu Xiangguo smiled and shook his head: "This kid..." There was no blame in his tone.
After Qin Xue signed the order, she and Lin Kun came out of the auto repair shop together. Xu Guangyuan escorted them to the car, and he didn't turn back until the red Cadillac completely disappeared from sight.
After returning, Xu Guangyuan found the master surnamed Yang and said to him: "Xiao Yang, you can rest for a while, I will do it myself!"
The Cadillac stopped outside the gate of Haichen Villa. Lin Kun was about to get out of the car when Qin Xue suddenly stopped him. Lin Kun turned around and saw Qin Xue looking at him with a smile: "Mr. Lin... give me that cigarette again."
Lin Kun was stunned for a moment, then smiled and took out a cigarette and lit it for her.
Qin Xue took a deep breath, seemingly intoxicated, and said, "This tastes really good... What's the name of this cigarette?"
Lin Kun also lit one for himself, blew out smoke rings and said: "The big green toad, the fierce smoke in Mobei, are all smoked by men."
Qin Xue asked with interest: "Where is the woman?"
Lin Kun said: "There are no women there."
Qin Xue didn't believe it.
Lin Kun said: "It's true, it's so poor there. The women have all married off, leaving only a group of old men who are fighting against us soldiers all day long. There are many unruly people in the poor mountains and rivers. This is not true at all."
Lin Kun took out the remaining half pack of cigarettes and threw it on the console. "This half pack is for you, smoke less."
Qin Xue smiled: "Thank you."
Lin Kun smiled and got out of the car. Qin Xue suddenly said to him: "When your car is repaired, will you take me for a ride?"
Lin Kun grinned: "It's an honor."
Lin Kun walked into the villa area carelessly, and Qin Xue also drove away in a Cadillac. On the way, she held a big green toad in her mouth, with a faint smile on her lips, and there seemed to be a spring breeze blowing on her cold cheeks.
Lin Kun hummed a tune and walked towards Villa No. 7. He planned to go back to eat something first, then go to the farmer's market to buy some rapeseed and vegetable growing tools, and take advantage of the free time in the afternoon to plant the small vegetable patch in front of the garage.
When passing by the door of Villa No. 6, he suddenly stopped and took two steps back. A not-so-familiar but familiar figure was cleaning the house in the yard. It was Zhang Xiaoya, the heroine who saved his life the night before. The steps in front of the villa were filled with large and small bags of luggage.
Lin Kun couldn't help but frown, why is this girl here? Wasn't there a family of four who lived in Villa No. 6 before? And... Xiao Chucheng later confessed that she was the one who came to the house to look for him in the morning. How did she know that she lived here?
If you have no doubts, you have to ask yourself if you want to find out.
"Ahem..."
Lin Kun walked into the courtyard and coughed twice on purpose. Zhang Xiaoya was sweeping the floor with her head down. When she heard the sound, she raised her head. When she saw it was Lin Kun, she immediately beamed with joy and said in surprise: "Brother Lin, why are you here!"
Lin Kun smiled and said, "Why did you move here?"
"I..."
Zhang Xiaoya hesitated. Of course she couldn't tell the truth, otherwise she would be regarded as a nympho by Lin Kun. Although she was quite a nympho this time, she couldn't be known easily. She said with a red face.: "I felt uncomfortable living in the dormitory, so I moved out. It happened that this family was selling a house, so..."
Since childhood, apart from concealing her life experience, Zhang Xiaoya has almost never told a lie. Before she finished speaking, her face was already red and hot. This was also because she was nervous about facing Lin Kun.
Lin Kun closed his eyes slightly and immediately knew that this little girl was lying, so he asked, "Really?"
"Really, really." Zhang Xiaoya nodded slightly, and her ears turned red.
